title: JOVRA export bundle manifest (export.json)
description: The manifest at the root of an export folder/zip (P1-11, P1-09 Share Pack, 'Export video + analysis'). Sessions travel as their own session.json (same schema as the sidecar); tables as CSV per the contracts in spec/contracts/csv. D5: shared exports exclude audio unless the user turned 'Include audio' on.
$comment: Schema 1.1.0 (T02) added, all optional: sessions[].eventLogVersion, facesBlurred, sharePack, file roles condensedMatch / highlightReel / viewerHtml. Published and versioned for coaches and future tools (story 219): additive minor versions only within major 1. A document stamped 1.0.x may carry none of them ($defs/v1_0).

eventLogVersion.description: Since 1.1.0. The log version this session's files were built from.

role.description: condensedMatch, highlightReel and viewerHtml (the Share Pack's static index.html) since 1.1.0.

contact.description: IDC Rule 07: the only public contact, as text.

facesBlurred.description: Since 1.1.0. On-device face blur was applied to the video files (estimated; may miss faces).

sharePack.description: Since 1.1.0. Present when scope is sharePack (N3): who it is for and what it holds. Private by default.

v1_0.description: What a document stamped 1.0.x may not hold: every field and enum value added in 1.1.0. A 1.0 reader decodes closed objects and rejects them, so a writer that uses any of them stamps 1.1.0 or later.
